## Episode Thesis

This episode of the Danish podcast 'Boligejerne' is an advisory discussion on how parents can help their children enter the housing market via 'forældrekøb' (parental property purchase). It covers financing models, tax treatment (virksomhedsordning, 22% vs personal rates), rental income/market-rent requirements, gifting allowances, and intra-family property transfers under public valuation rules. No publicly traded equities are analyzed and no investment recommendations are given.
